scripts.test:hex:class-c: files=$(find hex/test/class-c -type f -name '*.test.js' | sort); if [ -n "$files" ]; then node --test $files; else echo "No class-c tests"; fi
scripts.test:hex:candidates: files=$(find hex/test/unclassified -type f -name 'candidate-*.test.js' | sort); if [ -n "$files" ]; then node --test $files; else echo "No candidate tests"; fi
scripts.test:hex:unclassified: files=$(find hex/test/unclassified -type f -name '*.test.js' | sort); if [ -n "$files" ]; then node --test $files; else echo "No unclassified tests"; fi
scripts.test:hex: npm run test:hex:class-a && npm run test:hex:class-b
scripts.test:flow:witnesses: rm -rf .tmp/flow-traces && mkdir -p .tmp/flow-traces && files=$(find hex/test -type f -name '*.flow-witness.test.js' | sort); if [ -n "$files" ]; then FLOW_TRACE_DIR=.tmp/flow-traces node --test $files; else echo "No flow witness tests"; fi
scripts.test:flow: npm run test:flow:witnesses && npm run test:flow:artifacts
